headline: The G236 artifacts reveal two collections of numbered commands and at least one explicit intended file dependency. However, the released records do not establish whether these commands executed or whether the intended information transfer occurred. This illustrates a fundamental oversight limitation: reconstructing intended coordination from recovered artifacts is not equivalent to verifying coordination in operation.
